study: Ding et al. 2022 (Lancet Digit Health) - spatially aware GNN
endpoint: Gene mutations, CNAs, MSI status from H&E
n: dev TCGA-COAD 459 WSIs; ext TCGA-READ 165; CPTAC-COAD 161
reported_performance: CPTAC-COAD: mutations AUC 63.74-82.90; CNAs 62.39-86.08; MSI AUC 73.15 (95% CI 63.2-...)
image_to_protein_link: No - CPTAC used only as an imaging/genomic external cohort, proteomics not used
relevance: DIRECT PRE-EMPTION: H&E MSI prediction already externally validated on CPTAC-COAD, at AUC 0.73

study: Wang et al. 2023 (Cell Rep Med) - DL integrates histopathology and proteogenomics
cptac_cohort: CPTAC CCRCC, HNSCC, LSCC, LUAD, PDA, UCEC (no colorectal)
endpoint: Tumour vs normal, tissue of origin, TP53 mutation, stage; correlation of CNN features with proteomic/transcriptomic signatures
n: 2755 H&E slides, 657 patients; 5374 TCGA WSIs for independent validation
reported_performance: tumour vs normal AUROC 0.995; tissue of origin 0.979; TP53 and stage reported as harder tasks
image_to_protein_link: YES - states 'to our knowledge, there have been no prior attempts to correlate rich proteomic data with histologic features'; links CNN TP53 signal to proteome (neutrophil/macrophage fractions, inflammatory signalling)
relevance: Closest precedent for image-to-protein. Covers TP53, NOT MSI/MMR, and NOT colorectal

study: Liu et al. 2024 (npj Breast Cancer) - protein levels from unannotated slides
endpoint: Levels of 223 protein biomarkers + drug response from WSIs
n: TCGA-BRCA 1978 WSIs/1093 patients; CPTAC-BRCA 642 WSIs/134 patients
image_to_protein_link: YES - predicts measured protein levels directly from H&E, with CPTAC as an external protein cohort
relevance: Image-to-protein in breast; establishes the methodological template our MMR-protein claim would need to beat

study: Azuaje et al. 2019 (J Clin Med) - histology-proteomics in kidney
endpoint: Associations between proteomics and histology image features
image_to_protein_link: YES - earliest retrieved CPTAC image-proteomics ML study
relevance: Precedent that the CPTAC image+proteome pairing has been mined since 2019

endpoint: BRAF, EGFR, KRAS, STK11, TP53 mutations
relevance: CPTAC as an external mutation-prediction cohort already established (lung)

study: Shah et al. 2026 (Comput Biol Chem) - M3FusionNet
reported_performance: TCGA in-distribution AUC 0.99 (ER), 0.96 (...); combined TCGA+CPTAC model overall AUC 0.90; proteomics integration improved HER2 AUC by 2-3 points
image_to_protein_link: Partial - proteomics used as an input modality, not as a predicted target
relevance: Shows cross-commons TCGA->CPTAC biomarker transfer is an active 2026 topic

endpoint: TME quantification and prognosis in CRC

relevance: CPTAC-COAD already used as an external imaging cohort for CRC models
